metadata.description: Explicit fresh-test-world marker only. Saved gallery requires the production mod and its normal dependencies.

result.platformSizingPolicy: ceil(active rendered X/Z extent)+2 cells, in separate uniform-size grids
result.surfacePolicy: active rendered minimum Y equals 64 exactly; zero-Y-thickness planes only use gallery-only 1/1024 anti-z-fighting clearance; persistent existing mount payload / entity Pos

catalogue.classificationPolicy: Original V12 origin retained; NEW type absent only if all source members were absent; damaged source stations never restored
catalogue.displayPolicy: Original V12 retained; every NEW working functional type once in its canonical default pose. Compatibility aliases omitted. Other art/connection/mount poses are states of the same item.
catalogue.absencePolicy: Exact original v16 terrain analysis. 115 source-art rows expand to 120 distinct offered variants. RP entity presence in the original map was outside that terrain-only audit and is not inferred.
catalogue.diagnosticPolicy: 57 source defect model/dependency paths get empty labelled diagnostic platforms. They are not fabricated or registered blocks. Three valid rendered jungle-trapdoor variants also sit in error because the original unused particle texture is absent.
